messages:
maria: quick heads up — customer X asked for a 'shipping guardrails' capability. they want a lightweight way to define per-tenant rollout acceptance rules + automatic rollback triggers.

maria: problem statement: teams ship model rollouts but need deterministic fallback when quality or cost drifts. currently they manually monitor evals and flip switches.

devin: clarifying q — is this mainly about rollout automation (canary -> global) or about live per-request gating (reject/modify calls)?

maria: both, but priority #1 is rollout automation: canary traffic rules + acceptance criteria (metrics), then auto-rollback. #2 is per-request guardrails (safety/formatting) as a follow-up.

ashok: proposed goals: 1) define per-tenant acceptance spec (metrics + thresholds), 2) enable canary traffic with weighted routing + automated rollback when thresholds fail, 3) surface clear audit logs and reasons for rollback.

zoe: non-goals: full policy language or enterprise DLP integrations in v1. don't ship complex rule editor now — just JSON spec + templates.

andrew: success metrics we can measure: reduction in manual rollback ops (ops/time), mean time to detect regressions (MTTD) <= 5m for critical evals, and % of rollouts that auto-roll back correctly >= 95% on injected regressions in canary.

maria: acceptance criteria (v1):
- API: create Rollout object with fields: model_version, tenant_selector, rollout_percent_schedule, acceptance_tests (list of named metrics with comparator+threshold), evaluation_window_seconds.
- UI/Console: can start canary with preview of expected traffic and immediate dry-run evaluation.
- Behavior: when acceptance_tests fail for 2 consecutive evaluation windows, platform moves traffic back to control and marks rollout as 'rolled_back' with reason.
- Observability: per-rollout time-series for each metric, alert pinned to the rollout, and audit entry with the evaluation snapshot.

maria: example acceptance test (inline JSON template):
```
{
  'metric': 'human_eval_score.mean',
  'comparator': '>=',
  'threshold': 0.75,
  'window_seconds': 600
}
```
(we'll use single quotes in template; SDK will accept double quotes).

devin: edge cases to call out: small sample sizes during canary (need min-sample), noisy metrics (smoothing), and model latency degradation (mix of cost & user impact). propose min_samples=50 by default.

ashok: operational keystones: rollback must be <30s after decision; don't block host processes during rollback; support manual override (force-continue). alerts go to #incidents and tenant owner.

zoe: security/permissions: only rollout owners + org admins can create/approve production rollouts. APIs should respect tenant-scoped RBAC.

andrew: compatibility: fall back to 'fail-open' behavior configurable per-tenant — default is fail-closed (stop rollout). document explicitly.

maria: follow-ups and deliverables for PRD: 1) API proto sketch, 2) console mockups for canary start/rollback UI, 3) rollout lifecycle state diagram, 4) eval harness plan for automated regression testing.

devin: timeline ask: can we scope MVP to accept only scalar metrics (no composite metrics) to ship in 6 weeks?

maria: yes, MVP = scalar metrics only + basic console + SDK helpers. add composite metrics in second iteration.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: note: will need a migration plan for existing rollouts; flagging eng-platform for coordination.

maria: next step: i'll draft PRD with the above and paste link here. please react with :eyes: if you want to be a reviewer.

zoe: :eyes:

andrew: :+1:
